thread:
maya: pager triggered — autoscaler oscillation on eu-west GPUs, multiple runtime crashloops reported. 500+ failed requests in last 3m. CPU fine, GPU mem OOM spikes.

incident-bot: INCIDENT created: INC-2026-0483 · severity=P2 · channels=#incidents #oncall · assigned=maya

maya: stack traces show repeated CUDA OOMs and container restarts, looks correlated with scale events: 
```
E 03:14:22 runtime: cudaMemcpy failed: out of memory
W 03:14:23 container restart count=3 reason=OOMKilled
```

sam: oncall here, joining. quick ask — any customer-facing errors or elevated 5xx rates?

support-bot: Alert: Customer-facing 5xx rate up 18% for hosted inference in eu-west, primarily model=v1-large. Top affected customers: acme-inc, fastchatlabs.

eli: adding context — autoscaler observed sudden spike in pending pods and spun up nodes from 4 -> 14 in ~90s, then scale back to 6 immediately. We suspect rapid scale up + hot starts filling GPUs and exhausting memory due to parallel warmups.

jo: suggested mitigation: throttle autoscaler burst by setting `maxSurgeScale=2` and enable `scaleDownDelay=5m` while we stabilize. Can someone apply?

kiran: preparing patch, will propose `kubectl patch hpa inference -p '{"spec":{"behavior":{"scaleUp":{"policies":[{"type":"Pods","value":2,"periodSeconds":60}],"selectPolicy":"Max"},"scaleDown":{"stabilizationWindowSeconds":300}}}}'`

maya: +1 apply. Also we should cordon a couple of new nodes to stop further scheduling until runtime fixes. jo, can you cordon node group eu-gpu-burst?

jo: cordoned nodepool eu-gpu-burst-2 (3 nodes). preventing new pods.

sam: I’m going to pull GPU runtime logs from a crashed pod: `kubectl logs pod/serve-abc-123 -n inference --previous` — looks like memory allocator fragmentation followed by OOM on model load.

eli: immediate workaround: switch traffic for the heavy model to a smaller variant (v1-medium) via the router: `route set --model v1-large -> v1-medium for tenant=acme-inc` — that'll reduce memory per replica. Can we do a quick canary?

maya: do it. route the top 10% sample to medium for 60s then roll back if OK. also notify customers.

support-bot: Notifying affected customers: acme-inc, fastchatlabs — message templated, will post now.

incident-bot: NOTE: On-call handover in 30m. @sam currently primary.

kiran: implemented HPA patch and limited surge. Applied changes and restarted autoscaler controller. Patch diff: `+maxPods surge policy` `+stabilizationWindowSeconds=300`.

jo: restarted runtime service on 4 recently started pods to flush caches and free fragmented GPU memory: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/runtime -n inference` (safe for canary shards).

maya: good. monitor metrics: GPU usage, OOMKills, pod restart count, 5xx rate. set alert thresholds lower for the next 15m.

sam: metrics update — OOMKill rate dropping, pod restarts reduced from 12/m -> 2/m, 5xx rate decreased to +3% above baseline. still seeing occasional spike when bursts of requests hit cold models.

eli: we should hard-limit concurrent in-flight requests per replica to avoid mem pressure. Adding `--max-concurrency=4` on the entrypoint for heavy model pools. I'll push change to canary.

maya: approved. eli, deploy to 2 canary pods. if stable for 10m, roll to remainder.

eli: canary live. logs show concurrency cap enforced, no OOM so far.

jo: long-term follow-ups (to capture in postmortem):
- add damping to autoscaler to prevent >+50% scale delta in <2m
- tune runtime allocator / pre-warm to avoid fragmentation during rapid scale
- introduce a model-variant fallback policy in router to automatically fallback to lower-memory variant on OOM
- add a burst-protection admission webhook that enforces `max-concurrency` and `batch-size` on new pods

maya: customer impact assessment: partial for acme-inc and fastchatlabs for ~18m window, degraded for heavy generation tasks, most customers saw transient errors. No data loss. Recommend P2 and postmortem with follow-ups.

sam: handing off to eli for night monitoring. I’ll update PagerDuty and close rotation in 25m.

incident-bot: INCIDENT update: severity=P2 -> mitigated (service degraded) · actions=HPA patch, node cordon, route fallback, concurrency cap.

maya: thanks team. i'll draft the initial postmortem and include the action items. filing as INC-2026-0483-pm draft.

eli: I'll monitor next 2h and follow up on the runtime memory patch tomorrow morning. ping if anything flares. :thumbsup:
